T: Tiny door. Big teapot. Mad party.
D: A curious girl follows a white rabbit down a hole into a very strange world.
P: Serve dessert when the Mad Hatter's unbirthday party gets going.
S: Little butter cakes with white icing
Small vanilla cakes baked in a mini muffin tin at 175C for 12 minutes, iced white with eat me piped on top in pink.
the oysters in Tweedledum and Tweedledee's story

Freshly shucked oysters on crushed ice with a sharp mignonette of eschalot, red wine vinegar and cracked pepper, and lemon wedges. Finely dice 1 eschalot and mix with 80ml red wine vinegar, 1 tsp caster sugar and plenty of cracked black pepper, then chill for 30 minutes. Fill a large platter with crushed ice. Shuck 24 oysters, or buy them freshly shucked, and sit them on the ice. Spoon a little mignonette onto each just before eating and serve with lemon wedges.
Puff pastry hearts filled with strawberry jam and whipped cream
Puff pastry hearts baked at 200C for 12 minutes, split and filled with strawberry jam and whipped cream.
M: Mad Hatter's tea party finger sandwiches
the Mad Hatter's long tea table

Three kinds of crustless finger sandwiches, cucumber and cream cheese, egg and cress, and ham and mustard, stacked high on tiered plates. Boil 4 eggs for 10 minutes, cool, peel and mash with 3 tbsp mayo and salt. Mix 150g cream cheese with chopped dill. Spread 12 slices of soft white bread with butter. Make 2 rounds of thin cucumber and cream cheese, 2 of egg and cress, and 2 of ham and mustard, using 150g ham. Trim the crusts and cut each round into 3 fingers. Stack on tiered plates.
Croquet lawn chicken and leek pie
Chicken thigh and leek pie in a creamy thyme sauce

Chicken and leek pie with a creamy thyme filling under a puff pastry lid, baked at 200C for 25 minutes until golden. Brown 800g diced chicken thighs, then soften 2 sliced leeks. Stir in a spoon of flour, 250ml chicken stock, 200ml cream and thyme and simmer until thick. Pour into a dish, top with puff pastry and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.
W: Vanilla sponge sandwiched with strawberry jam, iced in pastel colours
Vanilla sponge baked in two tins at 175C for 25 minutes, sandwiched with jam and cream, iced in pastel colours with candles for nobody's birthday.
K: Drink me iced earl grey lemonade
Earl Grey tea with honey and lemonade, over ice

Earl grey tea brewed and cooled, mixed with lemonade and a little honey, served in teacups over ice. Brew 4 earl grey tea bags in 500ml boiling water and stir in a spoon of honey. Cool, then mix with 500ml lemonade and a squeeze of lemon. Pour over ice in mismatched teacups. Drink me, but not too much at once.

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep iced cakes in an airtight tin

ingredients.item: pink food colouring, a few drops

steps.text: Beat the butter and sugar until pale and creamy.
Beat in the eggs one at a time, then fold in the flour.
Spoon into a greased mini muffin tin and bake at 175C until risen and golden.
Cool the cakes on a wire rack.
Mix the icing sugar with the water until thick, then ice the cakes white. Tint a little icing pink and pipe EAT ME on top.

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, fill just before serving

steps.text: Cut hearts from the pastry sheets and lay them on lined trays.
Bake at 200C until puffed and golden.
Cool completely on a rack.
Whip the cream to soft peaks.
Split each heart in half, fill with jam and cream, then dust the tops with icing sugar.

dishes.n: Croquet lawn chicken and leek pie
dishes.make_ahead: Make the filling up to 2 days ahead and chill; top with the pastry and bake on the night

ingredients.item: sheet puff pastry (or 2 for a deeper lid)

steps.text: Brown the chicken in the oil in batches, seasoning with salt and pepper, then set aside. Slice the leeks.
Soften the leeks in the same pan.
Stir in the flour, then the stock, cream and thyme. Return the chicken and simmer until thick.
Pour into a pie dish and top with the pastry, pressing the edges down.
Bake at 200C until puffed and deep golden.

veg.n: Croquet lawn mushroom and leek pie
veg.make_ahead: Make the mushroom and bean filling up to 2 days ahead and chill; top with the pastry and bake on the night

ingredients.item: sheet puff pastry (or 2 for a deeper lid)

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches with salt and pepper, then set aside. Slice the leeks.
Soften the leeks in the same pan.
Stir in the flour, then the stock, cream and thyme. Return the mushrooms, add the beans and simmer until thick.
Pour into a pie dish and top with the pastry, pressing the edges down.
Bake at 200C until puffed and deep golden.

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep iced cake covered

ingredients.item: pastel food colouring, a few drops

steps.text: Beat the butter and sugar until pale, add the eggs one at a time, then fold in the flour.
Divide between 2 lined tins and bake at 175C until a skewer comes out clean.
Cool the cakes completely in the tins, then turn out.
Mix the icing sugar with the milk and tint in pastel colours.
Sandwich the cakes with jam, ice in pastel colours and add the candles.

dishes.n: Drink me iced earl grey lemonade
dishes.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep the tea chilled

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water, stir in the honey and remove the bags.
Cool the tea, then chill if you have time.
Mix the tea with the lemonade and a squeeze of lemon.
Pour over ice in mismatched teacups.

s.note: Little butter cakes with white icing
s.how: Beat 125g butter with 125g sugar, add 2 eggs and fold in 125g self-raising flour. Spoon into a mini muffin tin and bake at 175C for 12 minutes. Cool, ice white and pipe eat me on top in pink icing. Watch out for growing spurts.

s.note: Puff pastry hearts filled with strawberry jam and whipped cream
s.how: Cut 2 sheets of puff pastry into hearts and bake at 200C for 12 minutes until puffed. Cool, split in half and fill with strawberry jam and whipped cream. Dust the tops with icing sugar. Keep a close eye on them, someone always steals the tarts.

m.n: Croquet lawn chicken and leek pie
m.note: Chicken thigh and leek pie in a creamy thyme sauce
m.how: Brown 800g diced chicken thighs, then soften 2 sliced leeks. Stir in a spoon of flour, 250ml chicken stock, 200ml cream and thyme and simmer until thick. Pour into a dish, top with puff pastry and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

w.note: Vanilla sponge sandwiched with strawberry jam, iced in pastel colours
w.how: Beat 250g butter with 250g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 250g self-raising flour. Bake in 2 tins at 175C for 25 minutes. Sandwich with strawberry jam, ice in pastel colours with icing sugar and add candles. Happy unbirthday to everyone.

d.n: Drink me iced earl grey lemonade
d.note: Earl Grey tea with honey and lemonade, over ice
d.how: Brew 4 earl grey tea bags in 500ml boiling water and stir in a spoon of honey. Cool, then mix with 500ml lemonade and a squeeze of lemon. Pour over ice in mismatched teacups. Drink me, but not too much at once.
